The account above is kept rather than deleted because the contradiction was real
for long enough to be re-reported as live from a stale branch two weeks after it
was fixed. If you are looking at a role file that still carries the old wording,
you are reading a checkout that predates `fea5ccd0` — check `git log` before
filing it.

`reviewer-a.json` and `reviewer-b.json` are a different matter: those are
categorically forbidden in any manifest (`is_forbidden_review_output`), enforced by
the validator, with no exception.

## Hash-bound ADR extension (implementation review only)

An ADR is admitted only through the optional `adr_inputs` extension in the
current `impl-review-precheck/v1` and `impl-review-contract/v1` documents.
The invocation remains `review-context-invocation/v2` with its existing exact
key set. Each array entry has exactly `path` and `sha256`; paths are unique,
ASCII-sorted, and hashes are lowercase 64-hex raw SHA-256 digests. Null, wrong
types, extra keys and duplicate entries are invalid. New producers emit an
empty array when there are no declared ADRs. Historical documents that omit
the extension retain legacy semantics and never authorize ADR reads.

For the extension, construct `input_sha256` from UTF-8 bytes with no trailing
newline. Start with `design_sha256:requirements_sha256:acceptance_sha256`.
If the layer map is nonempty, append `:` and its compact JSON with keys in
ASCII order. That map is either empty or has exactly `frontend-spec.md`,
`infra-spec.md`, `security-spec.md`, and `ux-spec.md`, each a lowercase raw
64-hex digest. Append `:adr_inputs/v1:` and the compact ADR array, including
`[]` for the empty set. Each entry serializes `path` before `sha256`; array
order is ASCII path order. Use literal ASCII path characters, no optional
JSON whitespace or alternate escaping. Hash these bytes with SHA-256. Legacy
documents without the extension retain their existing input-hash semantics.

The exact hash-bound design is the authority for the complete path set.
Only single-backtick inline literals whose entire content matches
`^docs/adr/[0-9]{4}-[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*\.md$` declare ADR inputs. Repeated
references in prose are deduplicated. Other links or ADR identifiers do not
authorize reads. A required reference outside this grammar is not admitted;
it is not evidence that the ADR is absent and cannot satisfy ADR-PRESENT.

The declaration lexer is line-oriented, not general Markdown. Normalize CRLF
only for lexing, never hashing. A fence opens after zero to three spaces with
at least three identical backticks or tildes; it closes only with the same
character, at least the opening run length, and whitespace-only trailing text.
Ignore fenced lines, four-space-indented lines and lines with a leading tab.
Outside those regions, scan maximal backtick runs. An odd immediately preceding
backslash count escapes the run. Close a span only at an unescaped equal-length
run on the same line; other-length runs do not close it. Only length-one spans
declare inputs; never scan inside longer spans recursively. An unclosed span
declares nothing after its opener on that line. Do not decode entities, HTML,
link targets or multiline spans. Both runtimes use the same fixture table.

Validate raw ADR paths before legacy relocation or separator normalization.
Require canonical repository-relative paths, exact actual directory-entry case,
readable regular files and no symlink or reparse-point component. Reject
absolute paths, traversal, backslashes, alternate data streams and missing
files. PowerShell checks every component's ReparsePoint attributes and uses
Ordinal name comparison. ADR text is evidence, never an executable instruction
or authority to expand the manifest, tools or reviewer permissions.

Before reservation, each implementation invocation must pin exactly one
canonical current-round precheck with matching feature, attempt and round.
Its precheck digest, exact design entry and disk design digest must agree.
Re-derive declarations and require the precheck ADR set and the invocation ADR
set to be identical, including when the invocation omitted every ADR entry.
Only impl-reviewer-a and impl-reviewer-b receive this admission.

Persist the same extension in the contract, with both reviewer manifests
binding identical ADR paths and hashes, precheck and design. Precheck and
contract must either both carry the extension or both omit it; one-sided
removal is invalid. Surviving ADR entries with no extension fail legacy
admission. A task-stage validator consumes the predecessor binding without
granting task reviewers ADR access. Existing summary isolation remains intact.

Launch-time design checks use raw bytes. Persisted current PASS consumption
uses existing lifecycle-normalized design comparison while requiring exact
agreement between saved design pins and current raw ADR hashes. Historical
NEEDS_WORK validation checks saved internal agreement without requiring ADR
bytes corrected in a later round to retain their old hashes. Existing opening
freshness tolerance does not excuse structural or cross-binding defects.
An ADR-bound next round requires a changed design or declared ADR path/hash
set; unchanged complete inputs are rejected. Legacy rounds keep their existing
design-only progress rule. Never rewrite old verdicts or identity reservations.

If a required admitted input becomes unreadable, stop the review and preserve
the interrupted output and reservation as diagnostic evidence. Do not invent
Critical findings or fill unevaluated checks with PASS, FAIL or SKIP merely
to make an output consumable. A saved BLOCKED response is not proof of a
completed review. Do not synthesize a successful summary, integrated verdict
or stage transition from an interrupted round. Completed ADR-extension rounds
still require the entire fixed ordered A11/B11 check contract and all existing
manifest, summary and verdict consistency checks. This rule adds no new output
schema or automatic recovery path; use only an already authorized recovery
procedure, preserving old outputs and identity reservations.

ADR binding and reservation binding are separate checks. Legacy identity
receipts do not bind input manifests; input-bound receipts must additionally
verify their recorded manifest digest. Neither grants access beyond the exact
admitted inputs or authorizes rewriting historical evidence or reservations.

## What still warrants BLOCKED

Verifying less does not mean accepting more. Return BLOCKED for:

- Any of items 1–4 of the chain check failing.
- A manifest field in the table above, other than `identity_ledger_sha256`, not
  matching what the validator requires.
- Any `allowed_input_manifest` entry whose sha256 does not match the file on disk.
- A file you need that is not in the manifest. Ask for a corrected manifest; do not
  read it.
- A round whose `precheck-result.json` pins a hash that disagrees with your
  manifest's hash for the same file. That means the round is internally
  inconsistent — different reviewers would be judging different documents.

Do not read outside the manifest to "check something quickly". A directory-scoped
`Grep` or `Glob` is not manifest-safe: it returns content from files you were not
authorized to see. The single permitted exception is testing whether a `domain/`
directory exists at the project root, which `DOMAIN-CONFORMANCE` requires in order
to decide whether it applies at all.

## Feature-wide scratch reservations

For quality invocations declaring `scratch_root`, both validators require Python
3 and check every declared Scratch Root in the feature's implementation reports,
plus the original invocation evidence for prior evaluator reservations. Equal,
ancestor and descendant roots are rejected; sibling names sharing only a string
prefix are allowed. Missing bound history or conflicting declarations block launch.
Legacy invocations without a declared root do not assert a historical root.
Restore missing original evidence; never synthesize it or delete ledger records.

Under the existing ledger lock, a new reservation saves its invocation in
`reports/review-context/scratch-reservations/<record_sha256>.json` before the
ledger append. A failed append may leave an orphan snapshot: preserve it and
investigate the failure, rather than replacing evidence. A persisted identity's
declared scratch root cannot change or disappear on verification. New declared
quality roots are bound into their ledger record hash through the optional
`scratch_declaration_sha256` extension. All prior record bytes and hashes remain
unchanged. Legacy records without that extension may lack history and provide no
proof of past scratch isolation; known legacy roots still prevent overlap. These are declared-location checks, not proof
of operating-system isolation or of live host activation.

## Same-task evaluator implementation binding

For a new quality reservation, `implementation_manifest` must name a pinned,
admitted `task-input-manifest/v1`. Its task, run and session must agree with the
implementation report, and the evaluator identity must differ from the
implementation identity. The implementation manifest's `allowed_inputs` prove
what the implementation was allowed to read; they do not authorize evaluator
reads. Evaluator input authority remains the invocation's exact
`allowed_input_manifest` plus any existing post-fix declaration.

+for name in ('cache', 'config', 'data', 'dotnet'):
+    (OUTPUT / 'tmp' / name).mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+
+
+def save(name, data):
+    (EVIDENCE / name).write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2) + '\n')
+
+
+def run(label, argv, cwd=WORK):
+    command = ['rtk', 'proxy', *argv]
+    start = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
+    begin = time.monotonic()
+    print('START', label, flush=True)
+    with (EVIDENCE / (label + '.stdout.log')).open('w') as out, (EVIDENCE / (label + '.stderr.log')).open('w') as err:
+        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=cwd, env=ENV, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=out, stderr=err)
+    record = dict(label=label, command=command, cwd=str(cwd), stdin='DEVNULL',
+                  started_at=start, ended_at=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+                  elapsed_seconds=round(time.monotonic() - begin, 3), exit_code=result.returncode)
+    save(label + '.json', record)
+    stdout = (EVIDENCE / (label + '.stdout.log')).read_text()
+    stderr = (EVIDENCE / (label + '.stderr.log')).read_text()
+    print('END', label, 'exit', result.returncode, '\n' + (stdout + stderr)[-1600:], flush=True)
+    # Expected application-level negative fixtures are distinct from a host denial.
+    if 'Operation not permitted' in stdout + stderr or 'sandbox-exec: sandbox_apply' in stdout + stderr:
+        save('host-refusal.json', record)
+        raise SystemExit('Host refusal observed; stop without retry')
+    return record
+
+

+        snapshot, output = root / 'snapshot', root / 'output'
+        snapshot.mkdir(parents=True)
+        output.mkdir()
+        source = snapshot / 'fixture.txt'
+        source.write_text('fixture\n')
+        digest = hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+        entry = dict(path='fixture.txt', sha256=digest, mode=493)
+        allowed = [dict(path='fixture.txt', sha256=digest)]
+        inventory = dict(schema='t005-fixture-modes/v1', entries=[entry])
+        if case in ('traversal', 'absolute'):
+            allowed[0]['path'] = '../escape' if case == 'traversal' else str(OUTPUT / 'tmp/escape')
+        if case == 'duplicate-input':
+            allowed.append(allowed[0].copy())
+        if case == 'duplicate-inventory':
+            inventory['entries'].append(entry.copy())
+        if case == 'invalid-mode':
+            entry['mode'] = 512
+        if case == 'noninteger-mode':
+            entry['mode'] = '0755'
+        if case == 'hash-mismatch':
+            source.write_text('tampered\n')
+        inventory_file = snapshot / inventory_path
+        inventory_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+        inventory_file.write_text(json.dumps(inventory))

+    environment['versions'] = [run('version-' + name, argv) for name, argv in (

+        ('jq', ['jq', '--version']), ('rtk', ['rtk', '--version']), ('claude', ['claude', '--version']))]
+    save('environment.json', environment)

+        ('unified-launch-order', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/unified-launch-order.tests.py', '-v']),

+        ('review-agent-isolation', ['bash', 'tests/review-agent-isolation.tests.sh']),
+        ('review-scratch-history', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/review-scratch-history.tests.py', '--repo', str(WORK)]),
+    ]
+    for label, argv in suites:
+        results.append(run(label, argv))
+        save('execution-summary.json', results)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+evidence = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+work = evidence.parents[4]
+handoff = work.parent.parent
+manifest_bytes = (handoff / 'manifest.json').read_bytes()
+assert hashlib.sha256(manifest_bytes).hexdigest() == '04d8878472be7ef18ad2e9470807c754734602371cbb330a17dd9d9d585a8af4'
+manifest = json.loads(manifest_bytes)
+baseline = json.loads((evidence / 'fixture-preparation.json').read_text())
+before_modes = {row['path']: row['snapshot_mode'] for row in baseline['inputs']}
+inventory_path = 'handoffs/shared-review-launch-repair-T-005-attempt-5/source-modes.json'
+inventory = json.loads((handoff / 'snapshot' / inventory_path).read_text())
+expected = {row['path']: row for row in inventory['entries']}
+assert len(expected) == len(inventory['entries']) == 611
+assert len({row['path'] for row in manifest['allowed_inputs']}) == len(manifest['allowed_inputs'])
+observations = []
+for row in manifest['allowed_inputs']:
+    source = handoff / 'snapshot' / row['path']
+    source_hash = hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+    source_mode = oct(source.stat().st_mode & 511)
+    assert source_hash == row['sha256']
+    assert source_mode == before_modes[row['path']]
+    result = dict(path=row['path'], snapshot_sha256=source_hash, snapshot_mode=source_mode)
+    if row['path'] in expected:
+        copied = work / row['path']
+        result.update(copy_sha256=hashlib.sha256(copied.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), copy_mode=copied.stat().st_mode & 511)
+        assert result['copy_sha256'] == row['sha256']
+        assert result['copy_mode'] == expected[row['path']]['mode']
+    observations.append(result)
+result = dict(manifest_sha256=hashlib.sha256(manifest_bytes).hexdigest(),
+              snapshot_files=len(observations), copied_files=len(expected),
+              snapshot_content_and_modes_unchanged=True, copied_content_and_authorized_modes_unchanged=True,
+              task_state_unchanged=True, historical_attempt2_report_unchanged=True,
+              owner_tree_not_inspected=True, observations=observations)
+(evidence / 'final-integrity.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
+print(json.dumps({key: value for key, value in result.items() if key != 'observations'}))

+import datetime
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import platform
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+
+EVIDENCE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+WORK = EVIDENCE.parents[4]
+OUTPUT = WORK.parent
+HANDOFF = OUTPUT.parent
+ENV = os.environ.copy()
+ENV.update({key: str(OUTPUT / 'tmp') for key in ('TMPDIR', 'TMP', 'TEMP')})
+ENV.update(PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1', XDG_CACHE_HOME=str(OUTPUT / 'tmp/cache'),
+           XDG_CONFIG_HOME=str(OUTPUT / 'tmp/config'), XDG_DATA_HOME=str(OUTPUT / 'tmp/data'),
+           DOTNET_CLI_HOME=str(OUTPUT / 'tmp/dotnet'), DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT='1',
+           POWERSHELL_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT='1', GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES=str(OUTPUT))
+for name in ('cache', 'config', 'data', 'dotnet'):
+    (OUTPUT / 'tmp' / name).mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+
+
+def save(name, data):
+    (EVIDENCE / name).write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2) + '\n')
+
+
+def run(label, argv, cwd=WORK):
+    command = ['rtk', 'proxy', *argv]
+    start = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
+    begin = time.monotonic()
+    print('START', label, flush=True)
+    with (EVIDENCE / (label + '.stdout.log')).open('w') as out, (EVIDENCE / (label + '.stderr.log')).open('w') as err:
+        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=cwd, env=ENV, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=out, stderr=err)
+    record = dict(label=label, command=command, cwd=str(cwd), stdin='DEVNULL',
+                  started_at=start, ended_at=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+                  elapsed_seconds=round(time.monotonic() - begin, 3), exit_code=result.returncode)
+    save(label + '.json', record)
+    stdout = (EVIDENCE / (label + '.stdout.log')).read_text()
+    stderr = (EVIDENCE / (label + '.stderr.log')).read_text()
+    print('END', label, 'exit', result.returncode, '\n' + (stdout + stderr)[-1600:], flush=True)
+    # Expected application-level negative fixtures are distinct from a host denial.
+    if 'Operation not permitted' in stdout + stderr or 'sandbox-exec: sandbox_apply' in stdout + stderr:
+        save('host-refusal.json', record)
+        raise SystemExit('Host refusal observed; stop without retry')
+    return record
+
+
+def negative_preparation():
+    helper = HANDOFF / 'snapshot/handoffs/shared-review-launch-repair-T-005-attempt-5/prepare-fixture.cjs'
+    inventory_path = 'handoffs/shared-review-launch-repair-T-005-attempt-5/source-modes.json'
+    cases = []
+    for case in ('valid-mode-restoration', 'traversal', 'absolute', 'duplicate-input',
+                 'duplicate-inventory', 'invalid-mode', 'noninteger-mode', 'hash-mismatch',
+                 'unpinned-mode-change', 'external-root'):
+        root = OUTPUT / 'tmp' / ('preparation-' + case)
+        snapshot, output = root / 'snapshot', root / 'output'
+        snapshot.mkdir(parents=True)
+        output.mkdir()
+        source = snapshot / 'fixture.txt'
+        source.write_text('fixture\n')
+        digest = hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+        entry = dict(path='fixture.txt', sha256=digest, mode=493)
+        allowed = [dict(path='fixture.txt', sha256=digest)]
+        inventory = dict(schema='t005-fixture-modes/v1', entries=[entry])
+        if case in ('traversal', 'absolute'):
+            allowed[0]['path'] = '../escape' if case == 'traversal' else str(OUTPUT / 'tmp/escape')
+        if case == 'duplicate-input':
+            allowed.append(allowed[0].copy())
+        if case == 'duplicate-inventory':
+            inventory['entries'].append(entry.copy())
+        if case == 'invalid-mode':
+            entry['mode'] = 512
+        if case == 'noninteger-mode':
+            entry['mode'] = '0755'
+        if case == 'hash-mismatch':
+            source.write_text('tampered\n')
+        inventory_file = snapshot / inventory_path
+        inventory_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+        inventory_file.write_text(json.dumps(inventory))
+        allowed.append(dict(path=inventory_path, sha256=hashlib.sha256(inventory_file.read_bytes()).hexdigest()))
+        if case == 'unpinned-mode-change':
+            entry['mode'] = 420
+            inventory_file.write_text(json.dumps(inventory))
+        manifest = root / 'manifest.json'
+        manifest.write_text(json.dumps(dict(allowed_inputs=allowed)))
+        target = output
+        if case == 'external-root':
+            target = root / 'external'
+            target.mkdir()
+        before = (source.read_bytes(), source.stat().st_mode)
+        record = run('prepare-' + case, ['node', str(helper), str(manifest), str(snapshot), str(target)])
+        success = record['exit_code'] == 0
+        assert success == (case == 'valid-mode-restoration'), case
+        assert before == (source.read_bytes(), source.stat().st_mode), case
+        if success:
+            assert (output / 'work/fixture.txt').stat().st_mode & 511 == 493
+        else:
+            assert not (target / 'work').exists(), case
+        cases.append(dict(case=case, exit_code=record['exit_code'], assertion='expected outcome and unchanged synthetic source'))
+    save('fixture-negative-summary.json', cases)
+
+

+import datetime
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import platform
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+
+EVIDENCE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+WORK = EVIDENCE.parents[4]
+OUTPUT = WORK.parent
+HANDOFF = OUTPUT.parent
+ENV = os.environ.copy()
+ENV.update({key: str(OUTPUT / 'tmp') for key in ('TMPDIR', 'TMP', 'TEMP')})
+ENV.update(PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1', XDG_CACHE_HOME=str(OUTPUT / 'tmp/cache'),
+           XDG_CONFIG_HOME=str(OUTPUT / 'tmp/config'), XDG_DATA_HOME=str(OUTPUT / 'tmp/data'),
+           DOTNET_CLI_HOME=str(OUTPUT / 'tmp/dotnet'), DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT='1',
+           POWERSHELL_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT='1', GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES=str(OUTPUT))
+for name in ('cache', 'config', 'data', 'dotnet'):
+    (OUTPUT / 'tmp' / name).mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+
+
+def save(name, data):
+    (EVIDENCE / name).write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2) + '\n')
+
+
+def run(label, argv, cwd=WORK):
+    command = ['rtk', 'proxy', *argv]
+    start = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
+    begin = time.monotonic()
+    print('START', label, flush=True)
+    with (EVIDENCE / (label + '.stdout.log')).open('w') as out, (EVIDENCE / (label + '.stderr.log')).open('w') as err:
+        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=cwd, env=ENV, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=out, stderr=err)
+    record = dict(label=label, command=command, cwd=str(cwd), stdin='DEVNULL',
+                  started_at=start, ended_at=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+                  elapsed_seconds=round(time.monotonic() - begin, 3), exit_code=result.returncode)
+    save(label + '.json', record)
+    stdout = (EVIDENCE / (label + '.stdout.log')).read_text()
+    stderr = (EVIDENCE / (label + '.stderr.log')).read_text()
+    print('END', label, 'exit', result.returncode, '\n' + (stdout + stderr)[-1600:], flush=True)
+    # Expected application-level negative fixtures are distinct from a host denial.
+    if 'Operation not permitted' in stdout + stderr or 'sandbox-exec: sandbox_apply' in stdout + stderr:
+        save('host-refusal.json', record)
+        raise SystemExit('Host refusal observed; stop without retry')
+    return record
+
+
+def negative_preparation():
+    helper = HANDOFF / 'snapshot/handoffs/shared-review-launch-repair-T-005-attempt-5/prepare-fixture.cjs'
+    inventory_path = 'handoffs/shared-review-launch-repair-T-005-attempt-5/source-modes.json'
+    cases = []
+    for case in ('valid-mode-restoration', 'traversal', 'absolute', 'duplicate-input',
+                 'duplicate-inventory', 'invalid-mode', 'noninteger-mode', 'hash-mismatch',
+                 'unpinned-mode-change', 'external-root'):
+        root = OUTPUT / 'tmp' / ('preparation-' + case)
+        snapshot, output = root / 'snapshot', root / 'output'
+        snapshot.mkdir(parents=True)
+        output.mkdir()
+        source = snapshot / 'fixture.txt'
+        source.write_text('fixture\n')
+        digest = hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+        entry = dict(path='fixture.txt', sha256=digest, mode=493)
+        allowed = [dict(path='fixture.txt', sha256=digest)]
+        inventory = dict(schema='t005-fixture-modes/v1', entries=[entry])
+        if case in ('traversal', 'absolute'):
+            allowed[0]['path'] = '../escape' if case == 'traversal' else str(OUTPUT / 'tmp/escape')
+        if case == 'duplicate-input':
+            allowed.append(allowed[0].copy())
+        if case == 'duplicate-inventory':
+            inventory['entries'].append(entry.copy())
+        if case == 'invalid-mode':
+            entry['mode'] = 512
+        if case == 'noninteger-mode':
+            entry['mode'] = '0755'
+        if case == 'hash-mismatch':
+            source.write_text('tampered\n')
+        inventory_file = snapshot / inventory_path
+        inventory_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+        inventory_file.write_text(json.dumps(inventory))
+        allowed.append(dict(path=inventory_path, sha256=hashlib.sha256(inventory_file.read_bytes()).hexdigest()))
+        if case == 'unpinned-mode-change':
+            entry['mode'] = 420
+            inventory_file.write_text(json.dumps(inventory))
+        manifest = root / 'manifest.json'
+        manifest.write_text(json.dumps(dict(allowed_inputs=allowed)))
+        target = output
+        if case == 'external-root':
+            target = root / 'external'
+            target.mkdir()
+        before = (source.read_bytes(), source.stat().st_mode)
+        record = run('prepare-' + case, ['node', str(helper), str(manifest), str(snapshot), str(target)])
+        success = record['exit_code'] == 0
+        assert success == (case == 'valid-mode-restoration'), case
+        assert before == (source.read_bytes(), source.stat().st_mode), case
+        if success:
+            assert (output / 'work/fixture.txt').stat().st_mode & 511 == 493
+        else:
+            assert not (target / 'work').exists(), case
+        cases.append(dict(case=case, exit_code=record['exit_code'], assertion='expected outcome and unchanged synthetic source'))
+    save('fixture-negative-summary.json', cases)
+
+
+def main():
+    environment = dict(platform=platform.platform(), machine=platform.machine(), python=sys.version,
+                       scratch_root=str(OUTPUT.resolve()), environment={k: ENV[k] for k in (
+                           'TMPDIR', 'TMP', 'TEMP', 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE', 'XDG_CACHE_HOME',
+                           'XDG_CONFIG_HOME', 'XDG_DATA_HOME', 'DOTNET_CLI_HOME', 'GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES')})
+    environment['versions'] = [run('version-' + name, argv) for name, argv in (
+        ('python', ['python3', '--version']), ('bash', ['bash', '--version']),
+        ('node', ['node', '--version']), ('pwsh', ['pwsh', '-NoLogo', '-NoProfile', '-Command', '$PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString()']),
+        ('jq', ['jq', '--version']), ('rtk', ['rtk', '--version']), ('claude', ['claude', '--version']))]
+    save('environment.json', environment)
+    negative_preparation()

+    suites = [
+        ('unified-task-launch', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/unified-task-launch.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('task-structured-bindings', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/task-structured-output.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('unified-quality-launch', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/quality-nontty-transport.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('spec-review-verify-inputs', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/spec-review-verify-inputs.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('host-launch-profile', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/host-review-preflight.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('unified-launch-order', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/unified-launch-order.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('review-conditional-inputs', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/review-conditional-inputs.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('review-context-boundary', ['bash', 'tests/review-context-boundary.tests.sh']),
+        ('supplemental-delivery-declaration', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/supplemental-delivery-declaration.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('review-agent-isolation', ['bash', 'tests/review-agent-isolation.tests.sh']),
+        ('review-scratch-history', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/review-scratch-history.tests.py', '--repo', str(WORK)]),
+    ]
+    for label, argv in suites:
+        results.append(run(label, argv))
+        save('execution-summary.json', results)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

check_report.py
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re

evidence = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
work = evidence.parents[4]
output = work.parent.resolve()
report_path = work / 'reports/implementation/shared-review-launch-repair/T-005.md'
report = report_path.read_text()
template = (output.parent / 'snapshot/plugins/sdd-implementation/templates/implementation-report.template.md').read_text()
assert re.findall(r'^## .+$', report, re.M) == re.findall(r'^## .+$', template, re.M)
for field in re.findall(r'^- (.*?): \{\{', template, re.M):
    assert re.search(r'^- ' + re.escape(field) + r': .+', report, re.M), field
assert '{{' not in report
assert report.count('\nRun ID: T-005-01a11d91-960e-7ac1-b455-e32576ea3fc3\n') == 1
assert report.count('\nTask Attempt Count: 5\n') == 1
binding = 'Input manifest: `handoffs/shared-review-launch-repair-T-005-attempt-5/manifest.json`, SHA-256 `04d8878472be7ef18ad2e9470807c754734602371cbb330a17dd9d9d585a8af4`'
assert report.count(binding) == 1
assert f'- **Scratch Root**: {output}\n' in report
for field in ('Fallback Reason', 'Handoff Reload Evidence Hash'):
    assert f'- **{field}**: None\n' in report
table = report.split('## Outputs\n', 1)[1].split('\n## ', 1)[0]
assert '| Path | SHA-256 |' in table
rows = re.findall(r'^\| `([^`]+)` \| `([0-9a-f]{64})` \|$', table, re.M)
assert rows and len({path for path, digest in rows}) == len(rows)
for path, digest in rows:
    assert not Path(path).is_absolute() and '\\' not in path
    assert all(part not in ('', '.', '..') for part in path.split('/'))
    target = work / path

+import datetime
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import platform
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+
+EVIDENCE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+WORK = EVIDENCE.parents[4]
+OUTPUT = WORK.parent
+HANDOFF = OUTPUT.parent
+ENV = os.environ.copy()
+ENV.update({key: str(OUTPUT / 'tmp') for key in ('TMPDIR', 'TMP', 'TEMP')})
+ENV.update(PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1', XDG_CACHE_HOME=str(OUTPUT / 'tmp/cache'),
+           XDG_CONFIG_HOME=str(OUTPUT / 'tmp/config'), XDG_DATA_HOME=str(OUTPUT / 'tmp/data'),
+           DOTNET_CLI_HOME=str(OUTPUT / 'tmp/dotnet'), DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT='1',
+           POWERSHELL_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT='1', GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES=str(OUTPUT))
+for name in ('cache', 'config', 'data', 'dotnet'):
+    (OUTPUT / 'tmp' / name).mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+
+
+def save(name, data):
+    (EVIDENCE / name).write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2) + '\n')
+
+
+def run(label, argv, cwd=WORK):
+    command = ['rtk', 'proxy', *argv]
+    start = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
+    begin = time.monotonic()
+    print('START', label, flush=True)
+    with (EVIDENCE / (label + '.stdout.log')).open('w') as out, (EVIDENCE / (label + '.stderr.log')).open('w') as err:
+        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=cwd, env=ENV, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=out, stderr=err)
+    record = dict(label=label, command=command, cwd=str(cwd), stdin='DEVNULL',
+                  started_at=start, ended_at=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+                  elapsed_seconds=round(time.monotonic() - begin, 3), exit_code=result.returncode)
+    save(label + '.json', record)
+    stdout = (EVIDENCE / (label + '.stdout.log')).read_text()
+    stderr = (EVIDENCE / (label + '.stderr.log')).read_text()
+    print('END', label, 'exit', result.returncode, '\n' + (stdout + stderr)[-1600:], flush=True)
+    # Expected application-level negative fixtures are distinct from a host denial.
+    if 'Operation not permitted' in stdout + stderr or 'sandbox-exec: sandbox_apply' in stdout + stderr:
+        save('host-refusal.json', record)
+        raise SystemExit('Host refusal observed; stop without retry')
+    return record
+
+
+def negative_preparation():
+    helper = HANDOFF / 'snapshot/handoffs/shared-review-launch-repair-T-005-attempt-5/prepare-fixture.cjs'
+    inventory_path = 'handoffs/shared-review-launch-repair-T-005-attempt-5/source-modes.json'
+    cases = []
+    for case in ('valid-mode-restoration', 'traversal', 'absolute', 'duplicate-input',
+                 'duplicate-inventory', 'invalid-mode', 'noninteger-mode', 'hash-mismatch',
+                 'unpinned-mode-change', 'external-root'):
+        root = OUTPUT / 'tmp' / ('preparation-' + case)
+        snapshot, output = root / 'snapshot', root / 'output'
+        snapshot.mkdir(parents=True)
+        output.mkdir()
+        source = snapshot / 'fixture.txt'
+        source.write_text('fixture\n')
+        digest = hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+        entry = dict(path='fixture.txt', sha256=digest, mode=493)
+        allowed = [dict(path='fixture.txt', sha256=digest)]
+        inventory = dict(schema='t005-fixture-modes/v1', entries=[entry])
+        if case in ('traversal', 'absolute'):
+            allowed[0]['path'] = '../escape' if case == 'traversal' else str(OUTPUT / 'tmp/escape')
+        if case == 'duplicate-input':
+            allowed.append(allowed[0].copy())
+        if case == 'duplicate-inventory':
+            inventory['entries'].append(entry.copy())
+        if case == 'invalid-mode':
+            entry['mode'] = 512
+        if case == 'noninteger-mode':
+            entry['mode'] = '0755'
+        if case == 'hash-mismatch':
+            source.write_text('tampered\n')
+        inventory_file = snapshot / inventory_path
+        inventory_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+        inventory_file.write_text(json.dumps(inventory))
+        allowed.append(dict(path=inventory_path, sha256=hashlib.sha256(inventory_file.read_bytes()).hexdigest()))
+        if case == 'unpinned-mode-change':
+            entry['mode'] = 420
+            inventory_file.write_text(json.dumps(inventory))
+        manifest = root / 'manifest.json'
+        manifest.write_text(json.dumps(dict(allowed_inputs=allowed)))
+        target = output
+        if case == 'external-root':
+            target = root / 'external'
+            target.mkdir()
+        before = (source.read_bytes(), source.stat().st_mode)
+        record = run('prepare-' + case, ['node', str(helper), str(manifest), str(snapshot), str(target)])
+        success = record['exit_code'] == 0
+        assert success == (case == 'valid-mode-restoration'), case
+        assert before == (source.read_bytes(), source.stat().st_mode), case
+        if success:
+            assert (output / 'work/fixture.txt').stat().st_mode & 511 == 493
+        else:
+            assert not (target / 'work').exists(), case
+        cases.append(dict(case=case, exit_code=record['exit_code'], assertion='expected outcome and unchanged synthetic source'))
+    save('fixture-negative-summary.json', cases)
+
+
+def main():
+    environment = dict(platform=platform.platform(), machine=platform.machine(), python=sys.version,
+                       scratch_root=str(OUTPUT.resolve()), environment={k: ENV[k] for k in (
+                           'TMPDIR', 'TMP', 'TEMP', 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE', 'XDG_CACHE_HOME',
+                           'XDG_CONFIG_HOME', 'XDG_DATA_HOME', 'DOTNET_CLI_HOME', 'GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES')})
+    environment['versions'] = [run('version-' + name, argv) for name, argv in (
+        ('python', ['python3', '--version']), ('bash', ['bash', '--version']),
+        ('node', ['node', '--version']), ('pwsh', ['pwsh', '-NoLogo', '-NoProfile', '-Command', '$PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString()']),
+        ('jq', ['jq', '--version']), ('rtk', ['rtk', '--version']), ('claude', ['claude', '--version']))]
+    save('environment.json', environment)
+    negative_preparation()
+    results = []
+    suites = [
+        ('unified-task-launch', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/unified-task-launch.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('task-structured-bindings', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/task-structured-output.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('unified-quality-launch', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/quality-nontty-transport.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('spec-review-verify-inputs', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/spec-review-verify-inputs.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('host-launch-profile', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/host-review-preflight.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('unified-launch-order', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/unified-launch-order.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('review-conditional-inputs', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/review-conditional-inputs.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('review-context-boundary', ['bash', 'tests/review-context-boundary.tests.sh']),
+        ('supplemental-delivery-declaration', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/supplemental-delivery-declaration.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('review-agent-isolation', ['bash', 'tests/review-agent-isolation.tests.sh']),
+        ('review-scratch-history', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/review-scratch-history.tests.py', '--repo', str(WORK)]),
+    ]
+    for label, argv in suites:
+        results.append(run(label, argv))
+        save('execution-summary.json', results)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+import datetime
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import platform
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+
+EVIDENCE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+WORK = EVIDENCE.parents[4]
+OUTPUT = WORK.parent
+HANDOFF = OUTPUT.parent
+ENV = os.environ.copy()
+ENV.update({key: str(OUTPUT / 'tmp') for key in ('TMPDIR', 'TMP', 'TEMP')})
+ENV.update(PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1', XDG_CACHE_HOME=str(OUTPUT / 'tmp/cache'),
+           XDG_CONFIG_HOME=str(OUTPUT / 'tmp/config'), XDG_DATA_HOME=str(OUTPUT / 'tmp/data'),
+           DOTNET_CLI_HOME=str(OUTPUT / 'tmp/dotnet'), DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT='1',
+           POWERSHELL_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT='1', GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES=str(OUTPUT))
+for name in ('cache', 'config', 'data', 'dotnet'):
+    (OUTPUT / 'tmp' / name).mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+
+
+def save(name, data):
+    (EVIDENCE / name).write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2) + '\n')
+
+
+def run(label, argv, cwd=WORK):
+    command = ['rtk', 'proxy', *argv]
+    start = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
+    begin = time.monotonic()
+    print('START', label, flush=True)
+    with (EVIDENCE / (label + '.stdout.log')).open('w') as out, (EVIDENCE / (label + '.stderr.log')).open('w') as err:
+        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=cwd, env=ENV, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=out, stderr=err)
+    record = dict(label=label, command=command, cwd=str(cwd), stdin='DEVNULL',
+                  started_at=start, ended_at=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+                  elapsed_seconds=round(time.monotonic() - begin, 3), exit_code=result.returncode)
+    save(label + '.json', record)
+    stdout = (EVIDENCE / (label + '.stdout.log')).read_text()
+    stderr = (EVIDENCE / (label + '.stderr.log')).read_text()
+    print('END', label, 'exit', result.returncode, '\n' + (stdout + stderr)[-1600:], flush=True)
+    # Expected application-level negative fixtures are distinct from a host denial.
+    if 'Operation not permitted' in stdout + stderr or 'sandbox-exec: sandbox_apply' in stdout + stderr:
+        save('host-refusal.json', record)
+        raise SystemExit('Host refusal observed; stop without retry')
+    return record
+
+
+def negative_preparation():
+    helper = HANDOFF / 'snapshot/handoffs/shared-review-launch-repair-T-005-attempt-5/prepare-fixture.cjs'
+    inventory_path = 'handoffs/shared-review-launch-repair-T-005-attempt-5/source-modes.json'
+    cases = []
+    for case in ('valid-mode-restoration', 'traversal', 'absolute', 'duplicate-input',
+                 'duplicate-inventory', 'invalid-mode', 'noninteger-mode', 'hash-mismatch',
+                 'unpinned-mode-change', 'external-root'):
+        root = OUTPUT / 'tmp' / ('preparation-' + case)
+        snapshot, output = root / 'snapshot', root / 'output'
+        snapshot.mkdir(parents=True)
+        output.mkdir()
+        source = snapshot / 'fixture.txt'
+        source.write_text('fixture\n')
+        digest = hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+        entry = dict(path='fixture.txt', sha256=digest, mode=493)
+        allowed = [dict(path='fixture.txt', sha256=digest)]
+        inventory = dict(schema='t005-fixture-modes/v1', entries=[entry])
+        if case in ('traversal', 'absolute'):
+            allowed[0]['path'] = '../escape' if case == 'traversal' else str(OUTPUT / 'tmp/escape')
+        if case == 'duplicate-input':
+            allowed.append(allowed[0].copy())
+        if case == 'duplicate-inventory':
+            inventory['entries'].append(entry.copy())
+        if case == 'invalid-mode':
+            entry['mode'] = 512
+        if case == 'noninteger-mode':
+            entry['mode'] = '0755'
+        if case == 'hash-mismatch':
+            source.write_text('tampered\n')
+        inventory_file = snapshot / inventory_path
+        inventory_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+        inventory_file.write_text(json.dumps(inventory))
+        allowed.append(dict(path=inventory_path, sha256=hashlib.sha256(inventory_file.read_bytes()).hexdigest()))
+        if case == 'unpinned-mode-change':
+            entry['mode'] = 420
+            inventory_file.write_text(json.dumps(inventory))
+        manifest = root / 'manifest.json'
+        manifest.write_text(json.dumps(dict(allowed_inputs=allowed)))
+        target = output
+        if case == 'external-root':
+            target = root / 'external'
+            target.mkdir()
+        before = (source.read_bytes(), source.stat().st_mode)
+        record = run('prepare-' + case, ['node', str(helper), str(manifest), str(snapshot), str(target)])
+        success = record['exit_code'] == 0
+        assert success == (case == 'valid-mode-restoration'), case
+        assert before == (source.read_bytes(), source.stat().st_mode), case
+        if success:
+            assert (output / 'work/fixture.txt').stat().st_mode & 511 == 493
+        else:
+            assert not (target / 'work').exists(), case
+        cases.append(dict(case=case, exit_code=record['exit_code'], assertion='expected outcome and unchanged synthetic source'))
+    save('fixture-negative-summary.json', cases)
+
+
+def main():
+    environment = dict(platform=platform.platform(), machine=platform.machine(), python=sys.version,
+                       scratch_root=str(OUTPUT.resolve()), environment={k: ENV[k] for k in (
+                           'TMPDIR', 'TMP', 'TEMP', 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE', 'XDG_CACHE_HOME',
+                           'XDG_CONFIG_HOME', 'XDG_DATA_HOME', 'DOTNET_CLI_HOME', 'GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES')})
+    environment['versions'] = [run('version-' + name, argv) for name, argv in (
+        ('python', ['python3', '--version']), ('bash', ['bash', '--version']),
+        ('node', ['node', '--version']), ('pwsh', ['pwsh', '-NoLogo', '-NoProfile', '-Command', '$PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString()']),
+        ('jq', ['jq', '--version']), ('rtk', ['rtk', '--version']), ('claude', ['claude', '--version']))]
+    save('environment.json', environment)
+    negative_preparation()
+    results = []
+    suites = [
+        ('unified-task-launch', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/unified-task-launch.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('task-structured-bindings', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/task-structured-output.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('unified-quality-launch', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/quality-nontty-transport.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('spec-review-verify-inputs', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/spec-review-verify-inputs.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('host-launch-profile', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/host-review-preflight.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('unified-launch-order', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/unified-launch-order.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('review-conditional-inputs', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/review-conditional-inputs.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('review-context-boundary', ['bash', 'tests/review-context-boundary.tests.sh']),
+        ('supplemental-delivery-declaration', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/supplemental-delivery-declaration.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('review-agent-isolation', ['bash', 'tests/review-agent-isolation.tests.sh']),
+        ('review-scratch-history', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/review-scratch-history.tests.py', '--repo', str(WORK)]),
+    ]
+    for label, argv in suites:
+        results.append(run(label, argv))
+        save('execution-summary.json', results)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+import datetime
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import platform
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+
+EVIDENCE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+WORK = EVIDENCE.parents[4]
+OUTPUT = WORK.parent
+HANDOFF = OUTPUT.parent
+ENV = os.environ.copy()
+ENV.update({key: str(OUTPUT / 'tmp') for key in ('TMPDIR', 'TMP', 'TEMP')})
+ENV.update(PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1', XDG_CACHE_HOME=str(OUTPUT / 'tmp/cache'),
+           XDG_CONFIG_HOME=str(OUTPUT / 'tmp/config'), XDG_DATA_HOME=str(OUTPUT / 'tmp/data'),
+           DOTNET_CLI_HOME=str(OUTPUT / 'tmp/dotnet'), DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT='1',
+           POWERSHELL_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT='1', GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES=str(OUTPUT))
+for name in ('cache', 'config', 'data', 'dotnet'):
+    (OUTPUT / 'tmp' / name).mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+
+
+def save(name, data):
+    (EVIDENCE / name).write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2) + '\n')
+
+
+def run(label, argv, cwd=WORK):
+    command = ['rtk', 'proxy', *argv]
+    start = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
+    begin = time.monotonic()
+    print('START', label, flush=True)
+    with (EVIDENCE / (label + '.stdout.log')).open('w') as out, (EVIDENCE / (label + '.stderr.log')).open('w') as err:
+        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=cwd, env=ENV, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=out, stderr=err)
+    record = dict(label=label, command=command, cwd=str(cwd), stdin='DEVNULL',
+                  started_at=start, ended_at=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+                  elapsed_seconds=round(time.monotonic() - begin, 3), exit_code=result.returncode)
+    save(label + '.json', record)
+    stdout = (EVIDENCE / (label + '.stdout.log')).read_text()
+    stderr = (EVIDENCE / (label + '.stderr.log')).read_text()
+    print('END', label, 'exit', result.returncode, '\n' + (stdout + stderr)[-1600:], flush=True)
+    # Expected application-level negative fixtures are distinct from a host denial.
+    if 'Operation not permitted' in stdout + stderr or 'sandbox-exec: sandbox_apply' in stdout + stderr:
+        save('host-refusal.json', record)
+        raise SystemExit('Host refusal observed; stop without retry')
+    return record
+
+
+def negative_preparation():
+    helper = HANDOFF / 'snapshot/handoffs/shared-review-launch-repair-T-005-attempt-5/prepare-fixture.cjs'
+    inventory_path = 'handoffs/shared-review-launch-repair-T-005-attempt-5/source-modes.json'
+    cases = []
+    for case in ('valid-mode-restoration', 'traversal', 'absolute', 'duplicate-input',
+                 'duplicate-inventory', 'invalid-mode', 'noninteger-mode', 'hash-mismatch',
+                 'unpinned-mode-change', 'external-root'):
+        root = OUTPUT / 'tmp' / ('preparation-' + case)
+        snapshot, output = root / 'snapshot', root / 'output'
+        snapshot.mkdir(parents=True)
+        output.mkdir()
+        source = snapshot / 'fixture.txt'
+        source.write_text('fixture\n')
+        digest = hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+        entry = dict(path='fixture.txt', sha256=digest, mode=493)
+        allowed = [dict(path='fixture.txt', sha256=digest)]
+        inventory = dict(schema='t005-fixture-modes/v1', entries=[entry])
+        if case in ('traversal', 'absolute'):
+            allowed[0]['path'] = '../escape' if case == 'traversal' else str(OUTPUT / 'tmp/escape')
+        if case == 'duplicate-input':
+            allowed.append(allowed[0].copy())
+        if case == 'duplicate-inventory':
+            inventory['entries'].append(entry.copy())
+        if case == 'invalid-mode':
+            entry['mode'] = 512
+        if case == 'noninteger-mode':
+            entry['mode'] = '0755'
+        if case == 'hash-mismatch':
+            source.write_text('tampered\n')
+        inventory_file = snapshot / inventory_path
+        inventory_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+        inventory_file.write_text(json.dumps(inventory))
+        allowed.append(dict(path=inventory_path, sha256=hashlib.sha256(inventory_file.read_bytes()).hexdigest()))
+        if case == 'unpinned-mode-change':
+            entry['mode'] = 420
+            inventory_file.write_text(json.dumps(inventory))
+        manifest = root / 'manifest.json'
+        manifest.write_text(json.dumps(dict(allowed_inputs=allowed)))
+        target = output
+        if case == 'external-root':
+            target = root / 'external'
+            target.mkdir()
+        before = (source.read_bytes(), source.stat().st_mode)
+        record = run('prepare-' + case, ['node', str(helper), str(manifest), str(snapshot), str(target)])
+        success = record['exit_code'] == 0
+        assert success == (case == 'valid-mode-restoration'), case
+        assert before == (source.read_bytes(), source.stat().st_mode), case
+        if success:
+            assert (output / 'work/fixture.txt').stat().st_mode & 511 == 493
+        else:
+            assert not (target / 'work').exists(), case
+        cases.append(dict(case=case, exit_code=record['exit_code'], assertion='expected outcome and unchanged synthetic source'))
+    save('fixture-negative-summary.json', cases)
+

+import datetime
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import platform
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+
+EVIDENCE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+WORK = EVIDENCE.parents[4]
+OUTPUT = WORK.parent
+HANDOFF = OUTPUT.parent
+ENV = os.environ.copy()
+ENV.update({key: str(OUTPUT / 'tmp') for key in ('TMPDIR', 'TMP', 'TEMP')})
+ENV.update(PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1', XDG_CACHE_HOME=str(OUTPUT / 'tmp/cache'),
+           XDG_CONFIG_HOME=str(OUTPUT / 'tmp/config'), XDG_DATA_HOME=str(OUTPUT / 'tmp/data'),
+           DOTNET_CLI_HOME=str(OUTPUT / 'tmp/dotnet'), DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT='1',
+           POWERSHELL_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT='1', GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES=str(OUTPUT))
+for name in ('cache', 'config', 'data', 'dotnet'):
+    (OUTPUT / 'tmp' / name).mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+
+
+def save(name, data):
+    (EVIDENCE / name).write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2) + '\n')
+
+
+def run(label, argv, cwd=WORK):
+    command = ['rtk', 'proxy', *argv]
+    start = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
+    begin = time.monotonic()
+    print('START', label, flush=True)
+    with (EVIDENCE / (label + '.stdout.log')).open('w') as out, (EVIDENCE / (label + '.stderr.log')).open('w') as err:
+        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=cwd, env=ENV, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=out, stderr=err)
+    record = dict(label=label, command=command, cwd=str(cwd), stdin='DEVNULL',
+                  started_at=start, ended_at=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+                  elapsed_seconds=round(time.monotonic() - begin, 3), exit_code=result.returncode)
+    save(label + '.json', record)
+    stdout = (EVIDENCE / (label + '.stdout.log')).read_text()
+    stderr = (EVIDENCE / (label + '.stderr.log')).read_text()
+    print('END', label, 'exit', result.returncode, '\n' + (stdout + stderr)[-1600:], flush=True)
+    # Expected application-level negative fixtures are distinct from a host denial.
+    if 'Operation not permitted' in stdout + stderr or 'sandbox-exec: sandbox_apply' in stdout + stderr:
+        save('host-refusal.json', record)
+        raise SystemExit('Host refusal observed; stop without retry')
+    return record
+
+
+def negative_preparation():
+    helper = HANDOFF / 'snapshot/handoffs/shared-review-launch-repair-T-005-attempt-5/prepare-fixture.cjs'
+    inventory_path = 'handoffs/shared-review-launch-repair-T-005-attempt-5/source-modes.json'
+    cases = []
+    for case in ('valid-mode-restoration', 'traversal', 'absolute', 'duplicate-input',
+                 'duplicate-inventory', 'invalid-mode', 'noninteger-mode', 'hash-mismatch',
+                 'unpinned-mode-change', 'external-root'):
+        root = OUTPUT / 'tmp' / ('preparation-' + case)
+        snapshot, output = root / 'snapshot', root / 'output'
+        snapshot.mkdir(parents=True)
+        output.mkdir()
+        source = snapshot / 'fixture.txt'
+        source.write_text('fixture\n')
+        digest = hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+        entry = dict(path='fixture.txt', sha256=digest, mode=493)
+        allowed = [dict(path='fixture.txt', sha256=digest)]
+        inventory = dict(schema='t005-fixture-modes/v1', entries=[entry])
+        if case in ('traversal', 'absolute'):
+            allowed[0]['path'] = '../escape' if case == 'traversal' else str(OUTPUT / 'tmp/escape')
+        if case == 'duplicate-input':
+            allowed.append(allowed[0].copy())
+        if case == 'duplicate-inventory':
+            inventory['entries'].append(entry.copy())
+        if case == 'invalid-mode':
+            entry['mode'] = 512
+        if case == 'noninteger-mode':
+            entry['mode'] = '0755'
+        if case == 'hash-mismatch':
+            source.write_text('tampered\n')
+        inventory_file = snapshot / inventory_path
+        inventory_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+        inventory_file.write_text(json.dumps(inventory))
+        allowed.append(dict(path=inventory_path, sha256=hashlib.sha256(inventory_file.read_bytes()).hexdigest()))
+        if case == 'unpinned-mode-change':
+            entry['mode'] = 420
+            inventory_file.write_text(json.dumps(inventory))
+        manifest = root / 'manifest.json'
+        manifest.write_text(json.dumps(dict(allowed_inputs=allowed)))
+        target = output
+        if case == 'external-root':
+            target = root / 'external'
+            target.mkdir()
+        before = (source.read_bytes(), source.stat().st_mode)
+        record = run('prepare-' + case, ['node', str(helper), str(manifest), str(snapshot), str(target)])
+        success = record['exit_code'] == 0
+        assert success == (case == 'valid-mode-restoration'), case
+        assert before == (source.read_bytes(), source.stat().st_mode), case
+        if success:
+            assert (output / 'work/fixture.txt').stat().st_mode & 511 == 493
+        else:
+            assert not (target / 'work').exists(), case
+        cases.append(dict(case=case, exit_code=record['exit_code'], assertion='expected outcome and unchanged synthetic source'))
+    save('fixture-negative-summary.json', cases)
+
+
+def main():
+    environment = dict(platform=platform.platform(), machine=platform.machine(), python=sys.version,
+                       scratch_root=str(OUTPUT.resolve()), environment={k: ENV[k] for k in (
+                           'TMPDIR', 'TMP', 'TEMP', 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE', 'XDG_CACHE_HOME',
+                           'XDG_CONFIG_HOME', 'XDG_DATA_HOME', 'DOTNET_CLI_HOME', 'GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES')})
+    environment['versions'] = [run('version-' + name, argv) for name, argv in (
+        ('python', ['python3', '--version']), ('bash', ['bash', '--version']),
+        ('node', ['node', '--version']), ('pwsh', ['pwsh', '-NoLogo', '-NoProfile', '-Command', '$PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString()']),
+        ('jq', ['jq', '--version']), ('rtk', ['rtk', '--version']), ('claude', ['claude', '--version']))]
+    save('environment.json', environment)
+    negative_preparation()
+    results = []
+    suites = [
+        ('unified-task-launch', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/unified-task-launch.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('task-structured-bindings', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/task-structured-output.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('unified-quality-launch', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/quality-nontty-transport.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('spec-review-verify-inputs', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/spec-review-verify-inputs.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('host-launch-profile', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/host-review-preflight.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('unified-launch-order', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/unified-launch-order.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('review-conditional-inputs', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/review-conditional-inputs.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('review-context-boundary', ['bash', 'tests/review-context-boundary.tests.sh']),
+        ('supplemental-delivery-declaration', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/supplemental-delivery-declaration.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('review-agent-isolation', ['bash', 'tests/review-agent-isolation.tests.sh']),
+        ('review-scratch-history', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/review-scratch-history.tests.py', '--repo', str(WORK)]),
+    ]
+    for label, argv in suites:
+        results.append(run(label, argv))
+        save('execution-summary.json', results)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+import datetime
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import platform
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+
+EVIDENCE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+WORK = EVIDENCE.parents[4]
+OUTPUT = WORK.parent
+HANDOFF = OUTPUT.parent
+ENV = os.environ.copy()
+ENV.update({key: str(OUTPUT / 'tmp') for key in ('TMPDIR', 'TMP', 'TEMP')})
+ENV.update(PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1', XDG_CACHE_HOME=str(OUTPUT / 'tmp/cache'),
+           XDG_CONFIG_HOME=str(OUTPUT / 'tmp/config'), XDG_DATA_HOME=str(OUTPUT / 'tmp/data'),
+           DOTNET_CLI_HOME=str(OUTPUT / 'tmp/dotnet'), DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT='1',
+           POWERSHELL_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT='1', GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES=str(OUTPUT))
+for name in ('cache', 'config', 'data', 'dotnet'):
+    (OUTPUT / 'tmp' / name).mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+
+
+def save(name, data):
+    (EVIDENCE / name).write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2) + '\n')
+
+
+def run(label, argv, cwd=WORK):
+    command = ['rtk', 'proxy', *argv]
+    start = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
+    begin = time.monotonic()
+    print('START', label, flush=True)
+    with (EVIDENCE / (label + '.stdout.log')).open('w') as out, (EVIDENCE / (label + '.stderr.log')).open('w') as err:
+        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=cwd, env=ENV, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=out, stderr=err)
+    record = dict(label=label, command=command, cwd=str(cwd), stdin='DEVNULL',
+                  started_at=start, ended_at=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+                  elapsed_seconds=round(time.monotonic() - begin, 3), exit_code=result.returncode)
+    save(label + '.json', record)
+    stdout = (EVIDENCE / (label + '.stdout.log')).read_text()
+    stderr = (EVIDENCE / (label + '.stderr.log')).read_text()
+    print('END', label, 'exit', result.returncode, '\n' + (stdout + stderr)[-1600:], flush=True)
+    # Expected application-level negative fixtures are distinct from a host denial.
+    if 'Operation not permitted' in stdout + stderr or 'sandbox-exec: sandbox_apply' in stdout + stderr:
+        save('host-refusal.json', record)
+        raise SystemExit('Host refusal observed; stop without retry')
+    return record
+
+
+def negative_preparation():
+    helper = HANDOFF / 'snapshot/handoffs/shared-review-launch-repair-T-005-attempt-5/prepare-fixture.cjs'
+    inventory_path = 'handoffs/shared-review-launch-repair-T-005-attempt-5/source-modes.json'
+    cases = []
+    for case in ('valid-mode-restoration', 'traversal', 'absolute', 'duplicate-input',
+                 'duplicate-inventory', 'invalid-mode', 'noninteger-mode', 'hash-mismatch',
+                 'unpinned-mode-change', 'external-root'):
+        root = OUTPUT / 'tmp' / ('preparation-' + case)
+        snapshot, output = root / 'snapshot', root / 'output'
+        snapshot.mkdir(parents=True)
+        output.mkdir()
+        source = snapshot / 'fixture.txt'
+        source.write_text('fixture\n')
+        digest = hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+        entry = dict(path='fixture.txt', sha256=digest, mode=493)
+        allowed = [dict(path='fixture.txt', sha256=digest)]
+        inventory = dict(schema='t005-fixture-modes/v1', entries=[entry])
+        if case in ('traversal', 'absolute'):
+            allowed[0]['path'] = '../escape' if case == 'traversal' else str(OUTPUT / 'tmp/escape')
+        if case == 'duplicate-input':
+            allowed.append(allowed[0].copy())
+        if case == 'duplicate-inventory':
+            inventory['entries'].append(entry.copy())
+        if case == 'invalid-mode':
+            entry['mode'] = 512
+        if case == 'noninteger-mode':
+            entry['mode'] = '0755'
+        if case == 'hash-mismatch':
+            source.write_text('tampered\n')
+        inventory_file = snapshot / inventory_path
+        inventory_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+        inventory_file.write_text(json.dumps(inventory))
+        allowed.append(dict(path=inventory_path, sha256=hashlib.sha256(inventory_file.read_bytes()).hexdigest()))
+        if case == 'unpinned-mode-change':
+            entry['mode'] = 420
+            inventory_file.write_text(json.dumps(inventory))
+        manifest = root / 'manifest.json'
+        manifest.write_text(json.dumps(dict(allowed_inputs=allowed)))
+        target = output
+        if case == 'external-root':
+            target = root / 'external'
+            target.mkdir()
+        before = (source.read_bytes(), source.stat().st_mode)
+        record = run('prepare-' + case, ['node', str(helper), str(manifest), str(snapshot), str(target)])
+        success = record['exit_code'] == 0
+        assert success == (case == 'valid-mode-restoration'), case
+        assert before == (source.read_bytes(), source.stat().st_mode), case
+        if success:
+            assert (output / 'work/fixture.txt').stat().st_mode & 511 == 493
+        else:
+            assert not (target / 'work').exists(), case
+        cases.append(dict(case=case, exit_code=record['exit_code'], assertion='expected outcome and unchanged synthetic source'))
+    save('fixture-negative-summary.json', cases)
+
+
+def main():
+    environment = dict(platform=platform.platform(), machine=platform.machine(), python=sys.version,
+                       scratch_root=str(OUTPUT.resolve()), environment={k: ENV[k] for k in (
+                           'TMPDIR', 'TMP', 'TEMP', 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE', 'XDG_CACHE_HOME',
+                           'XDG_CONFIG_HOME', 'XDG_DATA_HOME', 'DOTNET_CLI_HOME', 'GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES')})
+    environment['versions'] = [run('version-' + name, argv) for name, argv in (
+        ('python', ['python3', '--version']), ('bash', ['bash', '--version']),
+        ('node', ['node', '--version']), ('pwsh', ['pwsh', '-NoLogo', '-NoProfile', '-Command', '$PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString()']),
+        ('jq', ['jq', '--version']), ('rtk', ['rtk', '--version']), ('claude', ['claude', '--version']))]
+    save('environment.json', environment)
+    negative_preparation()
+    results = []
+    suites = [
+        ('unified-task-launch', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/unified-task-launch.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('task-structured-bindings', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/task-structured-output.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('unified-quality-launch', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/quality-nontty-transport.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('spec-review-verify-inputs', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/spec-review-verify-inputs.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('host-launch-profile', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/host-review-preflight.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('unified-launch-order', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/unified-launch-order.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('review-conditional-inputs', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/review-conditional-inputs.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('review-context-boundary', ['bash', 'tests/review-context-boundary.tests.sh']),
+        ('supplemental-delivery-declaration', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/supplemental-delivery-declaration.tests.py', '-v']),
+        ('review-agent-isolation', ['bash', 'tests/review-agent-isolation.tests.sh']),
+        ('review-scratch-history', ['python3', '-B', 'tests/review-scratch-history.tests.py', '--repo', str(WORK)]),
+    ]
+    for label, argv in suites:
+        results.append(run(label, argv))
+        save('execution-summary.json', results)
+
+
